topic: remove a red wine stain from carpet
core_question: How do I get a red wine stain out of carpet? (secondary: How do I get a broken key piece out of a lock?)
answer_summary: Blot up excess wine immediately without rubbing, apply a solution of dish soap and hydrogen peroxide (or club soda), let sit, and blot repeatedly until it lifts, rinsing with cold water.; after the topic shift: Insert a broken key extractor tool (or two fine hook picks) alongside the snapped key fragment and gently pull it out along the pins, without pushing it deeper.
persona: tired and blunt; using casual slang
